output.summary: A flowering herb or short-lived perennial shrub native to Eurasia, black nightshade bears dull black or purple-black berries in bunches. This helps distinguish it from deadly nightshade, whose berries occur singly; black nightshade also has white rather than purple flowers.
output.edibilityNote: Only ripe berries and cooked leaves of known edible strains are food; unripe green berries and raw mature leaves can poison, and identification matters.
